responsibility: On-demand translation of a non-preferred-language memory: original/translation toggle (US-DIS-002 AC-4), cache-first lookup via TranslationCache TTL=7d (AC-2/AC-5), Apple Translation fallback with LanguageAvailability check (unsupported pair → unavailable, keep original + language label, ADR-013 decision 1), source-language detection uncertainty keeps original + language label (AC-3, ADR-005), only triggered on detail expansion (AC-1)

inputs.memory: MemoryDetailModel with sourceLanguage != preferredLanguage (needsTranslation), originalText, translationVisible, translatedText, translationConfidence
inputs.translationService: TranslationService protocol (display-layer) — cache-first, AppleTranslationService fallback (LanguageAvailability check + terminology-first + never-fabricated NLTagger confidence, 3F.9)
inputs.translationCache: any TranslationCaching (PersistentTranslationCache production TTL=7d file-backed / TranslationCache in-memory for tests)

outputs.visibleContent: Original text, translation toggle button, translated text (when available and source-language confidence >= 0.9), original text + language label (when confidence < 0.9 or pair unsupported), progress indicator while translating / availability-checking, L2 error toast + retry on failure
outputs.accessibilityTree: Toggle with value Original shown / Translation shown; translated body announced on completion

systemContainer: NavigationStack (memory detail push) + ScrollView content section + Alert/Toast for L2 retry
